Title: Online Shopping System
Description: The Online Shopping System facilitates product management, user registration, and the purchase of products. Administrators manage the product catalog, while users can browse, add items to a cart, purchase products, report issues, and access their accounts. The Backend Database System supports product information and user registration.
Domains: Customer Support | Database Management | E-commerce | Product Management | User Account Management
AllUseCases: Access Account | Add Product | Add To Cart | Buy Product | Delete Product | Recommend New Product | Register User | Report Technical Issue | Update Product Detail | View Product

Title: Administration Application
Description: The Administration Application provides functionalities for managing system operations, user access, and logging. The Website Administrator and Helpdesk interact with the system to perform tasks such as managing users, sessions, logs, and access control policies. System backups are performed as part of access control policy management. The Helpdesk primarily focuses on log and session management, while the Website Administrator handles a broader range of administrative tasks including user management.

AllUseCases: Manage Access Control Policy | Manage Logs | Manage Session | Manage User | Perform System Backup

The system supports issue reporting that can extend the product finalization process.

Title: Vehicle
Description: The Vehicle system manages core vehicle functions and passenger interactions. The Driver operates the vehicle, while the Vehicle Occupant interacts with accessories and enters/exits the vehicle. The system provides functionalities like driving, braking, controlling entertainment and climate, and managing vehicle access. The system interacts with the Driver to perform driving actions, and with the Vehicle Occupant to control accessories and manage entry/exit.
Domains: Automotive Engineering | Passenger Comfort Systems | Vehicle Access Control | Vehicle Control Systems | Vehicle Safety Systems
AllUseCases: Control Climate System | Control Entertainment System | Control Vehicle Accessory | Drive Vehicle | Enter Vehicle | Exit Vehicle | Open Door | Perform Anti Lock Braking

Description: The Airport system manages passenger check-in, baggage handling, and boarding processes. Airport Staff interact with the system to issue boarding passes and validate check-ins. Passengers interact with the system to validate their check-in (individually or in groups) and drop off baggage. The system includes processes for assigning gates and handling baggage, which are incorporated into other use cases.

Title: Sentinel EMS
Description: The Sentinel EMS system manages product definition, customer management, and environment configuration. Privilege Managers and Customer Service representatives manage customer data. Developers generate product keys, trial products, branded resources, and runtime installers. Product Managers define product features. The system includes functionality for defining both trial and full products, with trial products incorporating runtime installer generation. Environment management is included in branded resource generation and product key generation.

Description: The Appointment Booking system facilitates the scheduling of appointments between a User and a Service Provider. Users can initiate calls, while Service Providers manage technical issues and appointment slots. The Payment Gateway handles payment-related functionalities. Title: Satellite System
Description: The Satellite System manages the operation of a satellite, enabling payload status retrieval, command transmission (both real-time and stored), infrared sensor pointing, and orbital maneuvers. The system interacts with Payload Operators for status and sensor control, Flight Controllers for orbital adjustments, and Environmental Test Engineers for power generation testing. The Solar Simulation Chamber is used to test electricity generation.

SystemSynonyms: Mission System | UAV Planning | UAV Control
Title: UAV Mission Planning
Description: The UAV Mission Planning system enables an Operator to plan, execute, and monitor missions for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). The Operator interacts with the system to create missions, allocate UAVs, and evaluate mission outcomes. The system utilizes a Camera for image capture during missions, a Server for command processing and mission initiation, and GPS for coordinate management. The system supports creating markers and removing coordinates as part of mission definition, and sending commands to the UAV during mission execution.
Domains: Command and Control Systems | Geospatial Data Processing | Image Acquisition | Mission Planning | UAV Mission Management
AllUseCases: Allocate Uav | Assign Search Area | Capture Image | Create Marker | Create Mission | Evaluate Mission | Feed Command | Monitor Mission | Remove Coordinate | Send Command | Start Mission

The Controller manages chiller sequencing and temperature monitoring, while users are alerted to refrigerant leaks. Maintenance Operators provide maintenance services, which can trigger refrigerant leak alerts. Cooling services include monitoring chilled water temperatures. Commercial and Residential Users are specialized types of Users.
Domains: Building Management Systems | Chiller Plant Operations | HVAC Control Systems | Industrial Automation | Refrigerant Management
AllActors: Commercial User | Controller | Maintenance Operator | Residential User | User
AllPrimaryActors: Commercial User | Maintenance Operator | Residential User | User
AllUseCases: Alert Refrigerant Leakage | Control Chiller Sequencing | Monitor Chilled Water Temperature | Provide Cooling Service | Provide Maintenance

The Warehouse Manager segregates orders, views orders, checks parts, and registers parts. The system extends the 'Order Part' use case with a 'Check Part' function when parts are unavailable.

Title: Coffin Escape System
Description: The Coffin Escape System facilitates a stunt performance where an Escape Artist attempts to escape from a coffin. The system involves a Coffin Maker who ensures the coffin's quality, a Safety Officer and the Escape Artist who collaborate to minimize risks, and an Audience whose excitement is a key consideration. Computer control can be optionally enabled to assist with fluid pumping during the stunt. The system relies on pumping fluids and ensuring sufficient air within the coffin for the stunt to be performed.
Domains: Audience Engagement | Coffin Manufacturing | Risk Management | Safety Systems | Stunt Performance
AllActors: Audience | Coffin Maker | Escape Artist | Safety Officer
AllPrimaryActors: Audience | Coffin Maker | Escape Artist | Safety Officer
AllUseCases: Allow Stunt Fluid | Enable Computer Control System | Ensure Coffin Quality | Ensure Sufficient Air | Maximize Excitement | Minimize Risk | Perform Stunt | Pump Fluid

Title: POS
Description: The POS system facilitates retail transactions, user management, and activity analysis. Cashiers collect cash and process sales with customer interaction. Managers oversee cash collection and sales processes. System Administrators manage user accounts and security. The system integrates with external actors like the Accounting System and Tax Calculator for financial processing, and the Sales Activity System for data analysis. Returns are handled as an extension of the sales process under specific conditions.
Domains: Financial Transactions | Point of Sale Systems | Retail Management | Sales Analytics | User Account Management
AllActors: Accounting System | Cashier | Customer | Manager | Sales Activity System | System Administrator | Tax Calculator
AllSecondaryActors: Accounting System | Sales Activity System | Tax Calculator
AllUseCases: Analyze Activity | Collect Cash | Handle Return | Manage Security | Manage User | Process Sale

Title: Surveillance System
Description: The Surveillance System monitors a safe zone for sheep and bears, utilizing input from a Mission Operator, Ground Station, GPS Constellation, and Weather data. SystemSynonyms: Power Management | Distribution System | Energy System
Title: Energy Distribution Management System
Description: The Energy Distribution Management System facilitates the operation and monitoring of power distribution. The Grid Operator interacts with the system to record energy usage and authenticate themselves. The Control Center System is involved in selecting power sources, validating billing, and monitoring power flow. Use cases include generating reports, allocating power, checking transformer loads, activating backup lines, and selecting distribution areas. Authentication is required before selecting a power source, and billing validation includes report generation. Monitoring power flow can be extended by activating a backup line when the main power is unavailable. Transformer load checks are included in power allocation, and power flow monitoring includes transformer load checks.
Domains: Billing and Reporting | Energy Distribution | Power Grid Management | Power Supply Allocation | System Authentication
AllUseCases: Activate Backup Line | Allocate Power Supply | Authenticate Operator | Check Transformer Load | Generate Energy Report | Monitor Power Flow | Record Energy Usage | Select Distribution Area | Select Power Source | Validate Energy Billing

Title: Fire Alarm System
Description: The Fire Alarm System is designed to detect fires, alert users and authorities, and facilitate system maintenance and shutdown. It interacts with Technicians for initialization and shutdown, Maintenance Operators for fault handling and maintenance, Installation Personnel for system setup, Civilians who are alerted in case of false alarms or actual fires, Fire Department who are informed of fire events, and Sensors which detect fire events. The system also handles system faults and displays a standby state when no fire is detected.
